selectedImplementation: Saylo managed lexical and rule-based broad IPA

selectedData.name: CMU Pronouncing Dictionary
selectedData.licenseDescription: LicenseRef-CMUdict: permissive two-condition BSD-style notice; preserve the complete upstream text, including acknowledgments and disclaimer.
selectedData.commercialRedistribution: Permitted by the reviewed source/binary redistribution terms. Retain copyright, conditions and disclaimer in source; reproduce notices in binary documentation/materials.
selectedData.distribution: External plain-text dictionary and its exact LICENSE, explicitly installed. Neither file is downloaded during generation. Both are checked through ModelManagement; the opened dictionary is checked again before parsing.

spanishData.origin: Domain vocabulary authored for Saylo; not copied from an external dictionary, RAE page, TTS database or model.
spanishData.phonemes: Computed by original managed G2P rules; vocabulary membership limits coverage rather than supplying canned sentences.

alternativesReviewed.name: eSpeak NG
alternativesReviewed.capabilities: Local text-to-phoneme with broad language/variant coverage; native CLI/library, Windows/Linux/macOS support.
alternativesReviewed.decision: Not introduced. GPL permits commerce, but integration/distribution obligations require a separate product decision; process separation alone is not treated as a license exemption. No native TTS engine added.

alternativesReviewed.name: Epitran
alternativesReviewed.license: MIT for the reviewed core; full optional dependency/data chain not approved in this task
alternativesReviewed.capabilities: Rule/table-based IPA transliteration; English requires Flite lex_lookup in the documented setup.
alternativesReviewed.decision: Not introduced. Extra Python/native packaging and dialect/stress validation would be required for Windows; selected implementation needs no such runtime.

alternativesReviewed.name: Gruut lexical/POS/CRF phonemization
alternativesReviewed.license: MIT core; language packages, CRF/POS models, dictionary provenance and all dependencies not approved as one redistribution bundle
alternativesReviewed.capabilities: Contextual phonemization with lexicons and local CRF/POS models; documented en-US and es-ES; several normalization dependencies.
alternativesReviewed.decision: Not introduced. Promising context coverage, but more runtime/data dependencies, a separate Windows packaging assessment, and Latin American validation are needed. No model was downloaded.

benchmarkScope: Only the selected implementation was installed and measured. No invented latency, RAM or installation-size measurements for rejected alternatives.
productDistributionApproval: This records the selected pronunciation component and data; it does not supersede previous resource-license/distribution work for the entire Saylo product.
